title: openOODA Standard Library
content:
## What it is

The openOODA standard library. v1.0.0. Ships with the toolchain as a separately-installable package. 8 functional domains, 173 ANCHOR.oo indexes, zero `mod.oo` (banned), 256-line cap on every `.oo` and `.oot` file. Each module has a 4-element Academy header.

## Install

```sh
opm install openOODA/std
```

The std package refuses to run if the installed ooda toolchain is outside the declared range.

## Surface

The 8 functional domains:

| Domain | Scope |
|--------|-------|
| `app` | Application primitives: UI, I/O orchestration |
| `core` | Foundational types: `Option`, `Result`, `List`, arithmetic |
| `fs` | Filesystem operations under `&FsReadCap` / `&FsWriteCap` |
| `hw` | Hardware abstraction: SIMD, accelerators, low-level primitives |
| `meta` | Reflection, AST inspection, tooling primitives |
| `net` | Network operations under `&NetCap` (TCP, UDP, bind) |
| `science` | Hard-science primitives: math, physics, chem, bio, AI, economics |
| `sec` | Capability security: OCap tokens, Landlock, HMAC, taint tracking |

4 template dirs at the top level: `docs/`, `examples/`, `qa/`, `scripts/`.

## Version contract

```
std=1.0.0
oooda=2.10.0
ooda_max=2.99.0
oodac=2.10.0
api_surface=8
```

`api_surface=8` is a structural check: the loader asserts the std ANCHOR.oo exposes exactly 8 public subdirs.

See `openOODA/std/docs/` for the full reference: `STRUCTURE.oot`, `DOMAINS.oot`, `MIGRATION.oot`, `INSTALL.oot`.
